ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a dominant high-intensity white ventral field comprising approximately 85% of surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black pixel clusters at the periphery and scattered internal focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black band along the entire trailing edge topography. High-density black mottling at the distal tips. Sparse, isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (spots) distributed across the mid-region of the right lobe and lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth of depression occupies roughly 18% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the full trailing boundary. Prominent jagged peaks (3-8 pixels in height) and deep valleys are most concentrated on the outer distal third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a bimodal curve: transitioning from a slight convexity at the medial notch to a broad concavity across the central lobe, terminating in an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct yellowish-tan circular clusters detected on the lower-left lobe quadrant. Five discrete low-intensity (black) circular pixel clusters identified in a loose grouping on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least three parallel, low-contrast linear disruptions oriented diagonally on the left lobe; additional faint horizontal linear markings detected near the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of potential sessile organisms or associated scarring (yellowish circular anomalies) on the left lobe. Significant irregular gouges in the trailing edge topography on the distal right lobe that exceed standard serration amplitude.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical trailing-edge pigmentation bleed extending downward from the median notch apex.
